items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Parses component passport JSON ({identity, snapshots[]}) and outputs individual fields as Grasshopper-native types: the preview geometry (meshes, point clouds, authored shapes), the frame and the box on it, the condition grade, the origin (and whether the element is still in place), the elements left of a batch and the capture markers. Geometry is in the stored coordinates of the element, moved by its client-side csc_placement when it has one.
